legacy.policy: Only derived wire is evictable. Unique history has no automatic deletion or hard eviction limit. Warning is not a cap; low-space writes pause before the 256 MiB reserve. Export to separately verified storage and any later deletion require explicit user action.
legacy.limitations: Measured small retained partial sample only; not a complete-day growth measurement. Protected bytes include fixed day metadata and all retained provider/manual inputs, so per-capture is an upper-bound average for this dataset, not an incremental slope. More expiries, strikes, revisions, raw providers or lossless fields can change growth. Physical SQLite/WAL/runtime sizes are separate; clearing wire does not shrink unique history.
